feedback_storage: One origin-local document c08-motion-lab-feedback-v2 shared by Vanilla and Reactive. Original c08-vanilla-reviews-v1 data migrates without removing the original key.
review_counting: A score or a non-empty comment counts as reviewed without requiring a decision. Latest real feedback remains visible across animation versions and author-name edits. Earlier versions and tagged chat reports remain in history and exports.
export: Export all reviews JSON/CSV contains every saved collection, body, version and reviewer. Kept take manifest contains selected reviews, preview links and animation/data download URLs.
validation: All exports pass glTF with zero errors/warnings. All bone and skinned-vertex positions match actual displayed poses at five bake sample phases; max vertex difference 3.58e-7m.
limitations: Browser storage is local to the site origin; export to transfer feedback to another device or origin.
Animations contain the character and motion, not the stool or environment.
In-place exports retain vertical motion and local body sway; horizontal actor travel is removed.
A Keep decision records a reviewer recommendation, not automatic game-production clearance.
hash_normalization: JavaScript source hashes normalize CRLF to LF; binary GLB hashes use exact bytes.
kept_preview_body: Open take and kept-manifest preview URLs retain the selected body query.
